reactions.description: FasV catalyzes five successive chlorinations in the biosynthesis of naphthacemycin B13.

FasV, a flavin-dependent halogenase (FDH) that catalyzes five successive chlorinations in the biosynthesis of the naphthacene-containing aromatic polyketide naphthacemycin. This multiple halogenation reaction was elucidated to occur in an orderly fashion, as evidenced by enzyme kinetics, time-course assays, and computational simulations.
